crossRefs.note: who doesn’t need, like those high priests, to offer up sacrifices daily, first for his own sins, and then for the sins…
or else he must have suffered often since the foundation of the world. But now once at the end of the ages, he has been…
For the law, having a shadow of the good to come, not the very image of the things, can never with the same sacrifices…

translations.web: Thus they shall prepare the lamb, the meal offering, and the oil, morning by morning, for a continual burnt offering.”
translations.bsb: Thus they shall provide the lamb, the grain offering, and the oil every morning as a regular burnt offering.’
translations.kjv: Thus shall they prepare the lamb, and the meat offering, and the oil, every morning for a continual burnt offering.
translations.asv: Thus shall they prepare the lamb, and the meal-offering, and the oil, morning by morning, for a continual burnt-offering.
